<documents>
<document id="docs-account-details">
FindingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆYourˆroutingˆnumberˆandˆaccountˆnumberˆareˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails.ˆYou'llˆneedˆthemˆforˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆtoˆlinkˆTallowbrookˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆorˆtoˆreceiveˆaˆwire.ˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆfindˆthemˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆAccountˆdetails.ˆTapˆtheˆeyeˆiconˆtoˆshowˆtheˆfullˆaccountˆnumber.ˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆit'sˆyouˆfirst.ˆ##ˆCardˆnumberˆversusˆaccountˆnumberˆYourˆcardˆnumberˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆnumber.ˆDon'tˆgiveˆyourˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆanˆemployerˆforˆdirectˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆKeepingˆthemˆsafeˆOnlyˆgiveˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆtoˆpeopleˆandˆcompaniesˆyouˆtrust,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployer.ˆSomeoneˆwithˆtheseˆnumbersˆcanˆtryˆtoˆpullˆmoneyˆbyˆACH.ˆIfˆthatˆhappens,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆit.ˆ##ˆSupportˆwon'tˆreadˆthemˆoutˆForˆsecurity,ˆsupportˆwon'tˆreadˆyourˆfullˆaccountˆnumberˆorˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆyouˆinˆchatˆorˆonˆtheˆphone.ˆYouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆthemˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆWireˆinstructionsˆForˆincomingˆwires,ˆuseˆtheˆWireˆinstructionsˆscreenˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆwhichˆalsoˆshowsˆourˆSWIFTˆcodeˆforˆinternationalˆwires.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="transfers-recurring">
ScheduledˆandˆrecurringˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆscheduleˆaˆtransferˆforˆaˆfutureˆdate,ˆorˆsetˆoneˆupˆtoˆrepeatˆweekly,ˆeveryˆtwoˆweeksˆorˆmonthly.ˆ##ˆSetˆoneˆupˆTapˆTransfers,ˆchooseˆtheˆaccount,ˆenterˆtheˆamount,ˆandˆtapˆSchedule.ˆPickˆtheˆdateˆandˆhowˆoftenˆitˆrepeats.ˆ##ˆWhenˆscheduledˆtransfersˆareˆsentˆOnˆtheˆscheduledˆdate,ˆACHˆtransfersˆareˆsentˆinˆtheˆbatchˆbeforeˆ4:00ˆPMˆET.ˆIfˆtheˆdateˆfallsˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆholiday,ˆthey'reˆsentˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆNotˆenoughˆmoneyˆIfˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆtooˆlowˆonˆtheˆsendˆdate,ˆtheˆtransferˆisˆskippedˆandˆweˆnotifyˆyou.ˆWeˆdon'tˆretryˆit,ˆandˆthere'sˆnoˆfee.ˆFutureˆtransfersˆinˆtheˆseriesˆstillˆrun.ˆ##ˆChangeˆorˆstopˆEditˆorˆcancelˆaˆscheduledˆtransferˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtimeˆbeforeˆtheˆcutoffˆonˆitsˆsendˆdate.ˆ##ˆTransfersˆtoˆsavingsˆRecurringˆtransfersˆbetweenˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆhappenˆinstantlyˆonˆtheˆscheduledˆday,ˆincludingˆweekends.ˆScheduledˆtransfersˆcountˆtowardˆyourˆdailyˆandˆmonthlyˆtransferˆlimitsˆonˆtheˆdayˆthey'reˆsent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="fx-fees-plus-v2">
ForeignˆtransactionˆfeesˆonˆPlusˆOnˆtheˆPlusˆplan,ˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆisˆ1%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆinˆUSˆdollars.ˆ##ˆWhenˆitˆappliesˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrency,ˆinˆaˆstoreˆorˆonlineˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆprocessedˆbyˆaˆmerchantˆoutsideˆtheˆUSˆItˆdoesn'tˆapplyˆtoˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆabroad.ˆThoseˆhaveˆtheˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆinstead.ˆ##ˆExampleˆIfˆaˆpurchaseˆconvertsˆtoˆaˆgivenˆdollarˆamount,ˆtheˆfeeˆisˆ1%ˆofˆthatˆamount.ˆIt'sˆaddedˆasˆaˆseparateˆlineˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆcalledˆ"Foreignˆtransactionˆfee",ˆonˆtheˆsameˆdayˆtheˆpurchaseˆsettles.ˆ##ˆExchangeˆrateˆWeˆuseˆtheˆcardˆnetwork'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆtransactionˆsettles,ˆwithˆnoˆmarkup.ˆChooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆwhenˆaˆterminalˆoffersˆtoˆchargeˆyouˆinˆdollars.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆIfˆaˆforeignˆpurchaseˆisˆrefunded,ˆweˆalsoˆrefundˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆonˆtheˆrefundedˆamount.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆconvertedˆatˆtheˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆitˆsettles.ˆIfˆyouˆtravelˆoften,ˆPremiumˆhasˆnoˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
